note: Starting points, not legal or platform advice. Each selected entry must be checked against its official sources during planning (product-planner profile verify). Entries with lastVerified null have not been checked by the kit maintainers.
questions: Which platform or marketplace will this ship on (WordPress.org, WooCommerce Marketplace, Shopify App Store, app stores, web/SaaS, internal tool, library)?
Where are the users or the people whose data you process (countries/states, e.g. EU/EEA, UK, India, California)?
What personal data is handled (accounts, contact details, location, payments/card data, health data, children's data, none)?
Who pays, and how (card payments in the product, a payment provider's hosted checkout, invoices, free)?

profiles.title: Web application baseline
profiles.appliesWhen: Any product with a web UI or HTTP API used by people outside the development team.
profiles.ask: Is this a web app or API used by real users?

gates.title: Security controls checked against the chosen OWASP ASVS level
gates.architecture: Choose the ASVS level by risk (L1 for low-risk apps, L2 for apps with personal or financial data) and record authentication, session, access control, input validation and secrets handling decisions.
acceptance: Every applicable requirement of the chosen ASVS level is checked and the checklist is stored with evidence

gates.title: WCAG 2.2 AA for the user interface
gates.architecture: Record the component approach for keyboard access, focus order, labels, contrast and error messages.
acceptance: Main journeys are usable by keyboard alone with visible focus
Form fields have labels and errors are announced in text
Text contrast meets 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text)

gates.title: No known high or critical vulnerabilities in dependencies
gates.architecture: Record the dependency update policy.
acceptance: npm audit --audit-level=high (or the stack's equivalent) reports no high or critical vulnerabilities

gates.title: The full test suite passes
gates.architecture: Record the test runner and where tests live.
acceptance: npm test exits 0

gates.title: Type check passes (TypeScript projects)
gates.architecture: Record whether TypeScript or JSDoc types are used; remove this gate for untyped JavaScript.
acceptance: npx tsc --noEmit reports no errors

profiles.title: WordPress plugin
profiles.appliesWhen: A plugin for WordPress, especially one distributed on WordPress.org or sold.
profiles.ask: Will this plugin be published on WordPress.org or sold?

gates.title: WordPress Coding Standards: no errors
gates.setup: composer require --dev wp-coding-standards/wpcs dealerdirect/phpcodesniffer-composer-installer (allow the installer plugin in composer.json)
gates.architecture: Record the plugin prefix used for functions, classes, options, hooks and the text domain.
acceptance: phpcs with the WordPress standard reports 0 errors

gates.title: PHPStan level 5 or higher with WordPress stubs
gates.setup: composer require --dev phpstan/phpstan szepeviktor/phpstan-wordpress phpstan/extension-installer; add phpstan.neon with level and paths
gates.architecture: Record the PHPStan level and any baseline for existing code.
acceptance: phpstan analyse reports no errors at the configured level

gates.title: Compatible with the supported PHP versions
gates.architecture: Record the minimum PHP and WordPress versions (plugin header Requires PHP / Requires at least).
acceptance: PHPCompatibilityWP reports no errors for the minimum PHP version

gates.title: Input sanitised, output escaped, nonces and capability checks
gates.architecture: Record where requests enter (admin forms, AJAX, REST) and the sanitisation, nonce/permission_callback and capability used for each; database access uses $wpdb->prepare or WordPress APIs.
acceptance: Every $_GET/$_POST/$_REQUEST read is sanitised
Every output is escaped with the matching esc_* function
Every state-changing request verifies a nonce or REST permission_callback and a capability

gates.title: Internationalised strings and clean uninstall
gates.architecture: Record the text domain, and which options, tables and transients uninstall removes.
acceptance: User-facing strings use the plugin text domain
uninstall.php (or an uninstall hook) removes the plugin's options and data

gates.title: Plugin Check passes before release
gates.architecture: Record how Plugin Check runs (a local WordPress with the Plugin Check plugin, or wp plugin check via WP-CLI).
acceptance: Plugin Check reports no errors for the release build

profiles.title: WooCommerce extension
profiles.appliesWhen: A WordPress plugin that extends WooCommerce, especially one sold on the WooCommerce Marketplace.
profiles.ask: Will this extension be sold on the WooCommerce Marketplace?

gates.title: High-Performance Order Storage compatibility declared and honoured
gates.architecture: Record how orders are read and written (WooCommerce CRUD APIs, never direct post meta) and declare compatibility with FeaturesUtil::declare_compatibility('custom_order_tables', ...).
acceptance: The extension declares HPOS compatibility
Order data is accessed only through WooCommerce CRUD APIs

gates.title: Cart and Checkout blocks behaviour
gates.architecture: If the extension touches cart or checkout, record how it works with the Cart and Checkout blocks as well as the classic shortcodes, and declare compatibility.
acceptance: Cart and checkout behaviour is verified with the Cart and Checkout blocks and the classic shortcode pages

gates.title: QIT test suites pass before Marketplace submission
gates.architecture: Record which QIT suites apply and who runs them (QIT needs a Woo partner account).
acceptance: The applicable QIT suites pass for the release build, or the gap is recorded for the release owner

profiles.title: Shopify app
profiles.appliesWhen: An app for Shopify merchants, especially a public app in the Shopify App Store.
profiles.ask: Will this be a public Shopify App Store app, and does it embed in the Shopify admin?

gates.title: Mandatory privacy webhooks implemented
gates.architecture: Record how customers/data_request, customers/redact and shop/redact reach every store of merchant and customer data.
acceptance: customers/data_request, customers/redact and shop/redact are subscribed and handled, with tests

gates.title: Webhook HMAC verification
gates.architecture: Record where webhook signatures are verified before processing.
acceptance: Webhooks with a missing or invalid HMAC are rejected with 401, with tests

gates.title: Embedded app authentication with session tokens
gates.architecture: Record the OAuth/token exchange flow and session storage.
acceptance: Embedded requests authenticate with session tokens, not third-party cookies

gates.title: Admin UI follows Polaris and App Bridge
gates.architecture: Record the UI component approach (Polaris components, App Bridge for navigation, modals and toasts).
acceptance: Admin screens use Polaris components and App Bridge navigation

gates.title: App Store requirements checklist (and Built for Shopify where targeted)
gates.architecture: Record which requirements apply and which Built for Shopify criteria are targeted.
acceptance: The App Store requirements checklist is completed with evidence before submission

profiles.title: GDPR (EU/EEA)
profiles.appliesWhen: Personal data of people in the EU/EEA is processed, or goods/services are offered to them, wherever the business is based.
profiles.ask: Will people in the EU/EEA use the product or have their personal data processed?

gates.title: Personal data inventory and lawful basis
gates.architecture: List each personal data field, its purpose, lawful basis, storage location and retention period.
acceptance: Every stored personal data field has a recorded purpose, basis, location and retention period

gates.title: Access, export, correction and deletion requests
gates.architecture: Record how a data subject request reaches every data store, backups and processors.
acceptance: A user's data can be exported in a machine-readable format
Deleting a user removes or anonymises their data in every store, with tests

gates.title: Consent captured and recorded where consent is the basis
gates.architecture: Record what needs consent (for example marketing email, non-essential cookies) and how consent and withdrawal are stored.
acceptance: Consent is opt-in, recorded with time and version, and can be withdrawn as easily as given

gates.title: Security of processing and breach detection
gates.architecture: Record encryption in transit and at rest, access control to personal data and the access/audit log.
acceptance: Personal data is encrypted in transit and at rest
Access to personal data is logged

gates.title: Privacy notice, processor agreements, international transfers and DPIA need legal review
gates.architecture: Record the hosting region and every processor (sub-processor list).

profiles.title: UK GDPR and Data Protection Act 2018
profiles.appliesWhen: Personal data of people in the UK is processed.
profiles.ask: Will people in the UK use the product?

sources.title: ICO guide to the UK GDPR

gates.title: Personal data inventory and lawful basis
gates.architecture: As for GDPR.
acceptance: Every stored personal data field has a recorded purpose, basis, location and retention period

gates.title: Access, export, correction and deletion requests
gates.architecture: As for GDPR.
acceptance: A user's data can be exported
Deleting a user removes or anonymises their data in every store, with tests

gates.title: UK privacy notice, transfers and ICO registration need legal review
gates.architecture: Record the hosting region.

profiles.title: CCPA/CPRA (California)
profiles.appliesWhen: A for-profit business above the law's thresholds collects personal information of California residents.
profiles.ask: Will California residents use the product, and does the business meet CCPA thresholds (revenue, volume of consumers, or share of revenue from selling/sharing data)?

gates.title: Personal information inventory
gates.architecture: List categories of personal information, sources, purposes and whether any is sold or shared.
acceptance: Every category of personal information has a recorded purpose and retention period

gates.title: Know, delete, correct and opt-out requests
gates.architecture: Record how requests are verified and fulfilled across stores and service providers.
acceptance: Know, delete and correct requests are supported end to end, with tests

gates.title: Opt-out of sale/sharing honoured where applicable
gates.architecture: Record whether data is sold or shared for cross-context advertising, and how opt-out (including Global Privacy Control) is honoured.
acceptance: If data is sold or shared, opt-out requests and Global Privacy Control signals stop it

gates.title: Threshold applicability, notice at collection and privacy policy need legal review

profiles.title: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (India)
profiles.appliesWhen: Digital personal data is processed in India, or outside India in connection with offering goods/services to people in India.
profiles.ask: Will people in India use the product or have their personal data processed?

sources.title: Ministry of Electronics and IT: DPDP Act and Rules

gates.title: Personal data inventory and purpose
gates.architecture: List each personal data field, the specified purpose and retention.
acceptance: Every stored personal data field has a recorded purpose and retention period

gates.title: Notice and consent records, with withdrawal
gates.architecture: Record how notice is shown, how consent is captured per purpose and stored, and how withdrawal stops processing.
acceptance: Consent is captured per purpose with an itemised notice, recorded, and can be withdrawn as easily as given

gates.title: Access, correction, erasure and grievance requests
gates.architecture: Record how requests and grievances are received and fulfilled across stores.
acceptance: Access, correction and erasure requests are supported end to end, with tests
A grievance contact is shown in the product

gates.title: Reasonable security safeguards and breach handling
gates.architecture: Record encryption, access control, logging and the breach notification procedure.
acceptance: Personal data is encrypted in transit and at rest
Access to personal data is logged

gates.title: Children's data, Significant Data Fiduciary status, transfers and Rules timelines need legal review

profiles.title: PCI DSS (card payments)
profiles.appliesWhen: The product stores, processes or transmits payment card data.
profiles.ask: Will card payments be taken, and through a payment provider's hosted fields/checkout or your own forms?

gates.title: Card data never touches the product's servers
gates.architecture: Use the payment provider's hosted checkout or hosted fields so card numbers go straight to the provider; record the integration and webhook verification.
acceptance: No card number, CVV or track data is stored, logged or transmitted by the product's servers
Payment webhooks are signature-verified

gates.title: Self-assessment questionnaire type and attestation need review with the payment provider

profiles.title: HIPAA (US health information)
profiles.appliesWhen: A US covered entity or business associate handles protected health information.
profiles.ask: Will the product handle health information for US healthcare providers, plans or their vendors?

gates.title: Technical safeguards for PHI
gates.architecture: Record access control, unique user identification, audit controls, integrity controls and transmission security for PHI.
acceptance: PHI access requires authenticated, authorised users and is audit-logged
PHI is encrypted in transit and at rest

gates.title: Business associate agreements and risk analysis need legal review
gates.architecture: Record every vendor that can access PHI.

profiles.title: COPPA (US children under 13)
profiles.appliesWhen: The product is directed to children under 13 in the US, or knowingly collects their personal information.
profiles.ask: Is the product aimed at children, or could children under 13 sign up?

gates.title: Age screening and verifiable parental consent
gates.architecture: Record the age gate and the parental consent method before any personal information of a child is collected.
acceptance: No personal information is collected from a user identified as under 13 before verifiable parental consent

gates.title: Children's privacy notice and consent method need legal review
